title: Offer ultracode (/effort ultracode) on models that only advertise max effort
description: Ultracode is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflow orchestration, gated on the model advertising xhigh support. Models such as opus-4-6 and sonnet-4-6 support max effort but are not on that list. Forcing the capability check true unlocks it.

sites.description: The xhigh-effort capability check. Three gates depend on it — availability, the resolver that degrades xhigh to high, and the active check requiring exactly "xhigh" — so forcing this one true unlocks all three, where the standalone script rewrote each separately. One site instead of three is a smaller surface and cannot get them out of step. Identified as the single one-parameter function mentioning "xhigh_effort" alongside a model list.
